newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SHARES GAIN, SNAIGE ACTIVE IN BLOCK TRADING.
newsitem.headline: SHARES GAIN, SNAIGE ACTIVE IN BLOCK TRADING.

text.p: *Snaige shares turned over 263,000 litas in block trades and its shares on the central market increased to 11.50 litas from 11.00 litas
*Rokishkis Cheese shares jumped to 43.50 litas from 40.00 litas in turnover on the central market of 118,000 litas.
*The index of the official trading list was up 23.59 points to 922.49 points.
*Group A stocks advanced to 2152.62, a gain of 7.87 points.
*Turnover on the central market was 630,000 litas, up from about 360,000 litas.
*Block trades were down to one million litas from 2.4 million litas.
Lithuanian shares gained slightly on Monday and fridge maker Snaige was active, dealers said.
The index of the official trading list gained 23.59 points, moving up to 922.49 points.
The group A index advanced to 2152.62, a gain of 7.87 points.
"I think the turn around is already starting because the prices are so low," said one broker. "The general trend is up."
Snaige turned over 263,000 litas in block trades on Monday, in what appeared to be heavy interest from an Estonian Bank.
The block trades amounted to 1.7 percent of Snaige's share capital.
"I know that Hansapank bought 5 percent of the company last week, but I don't know who bought 1.7 percent today," said Snaige President Antanas Andrulionis.
One broker said he was certain today's transaction invloved an Estonian bank, but he declined to mention which.
"I know it's an Estonian bank," said Tomas Andrejauskas, a broker with Suprema.
Snaige shares gained 29.4 percent last week -- jumping 10 percent on Saturday alone after a large block trade the day before.
Snaige's turnover in block trades last week amounted to 1.2 million litas.
Snaige shares gained 4.55 percent on the central market Monday, moving up to 11.50 litas from 11.00 litas.
Rokishkis Cheese shares also continued to advance, moving up to 43.50 litas from 40.00 litas, on central market turnover of 118,000 litas.
"If the price goes below 45.00 litas a share, it becomes attractive," Andrejauskas said about Rokishkis.
-- Burton Frierson, Vilnius newsroom +370 2 22 35 18
